comment: Each make target of CHECK_TARGETS declares its scope and the setup steps it needs: needs ["databases"] is a target that reads the servers of make test-servers and the bench and decimal databases of the run, which the runner records as not-run, with the failed step and its first failure lines, when the setup step servers or databases/create fails; needs [] runs whatever the setup steps did. The other needs are the tools that the CI setup steps install (scripts/check/ci-setup.mjs): go, rust, php, php-min, composer, node-modules, libclang and server-programs; when such a step fails in CI, the runner records the targets that need it as not-run with that step, and runs every other target. A local run has no CI setup steps. An owner target is a per-file check (format, checklist, documents, the unit tests of a checker): make owner-check runs it when a changed path matches its inputs. A suite target is part of the full suite only: make check runs it once, and make owner-check never selects it; a changed feature's own verification and coverage run in its place. make owner-check and make repo-check fail on a target without a scope, an owner target without inputs, a suite target with inputs, and an input pattern that matches no tracked file. A pattern matches a repository path: * within one path segment, ** across segments.

.github/runner.reason: it names the runner image of every job of the CI workflow, so it changes the machine that runs every target

.github/workflows/ci.yml.reason: it defines the CI job that installs the toolchains and runs make check, so it changes how every target runs in CI

.github/workflows/docs-pages.yml.reason: it builds and publishes the documentation site from every document on each push, so it changes the publication of every page

scripts/ci/server-programs.sh.reason: the CI setup step server-programs runs it to install the programs of the database servers on the Linux runner, so it changes the servers of every database target in CI

scripts/ci/php-extension-tools.sh.reason: the CI setup step php-extension-tools runs it to install the libclang that the build of the PHP extension orm_dbspec reads, so it gates the PHP extension targets in CI

scripts/ci/php-sqlite.php.reason: the CI setup step php-sqlite runs it to check the SQLite that the PHP of the runner links, so it gates every PHP target in CI

.gitignore.reason: it only decides which files git ignores; no test reads it, and owner-check and make check list changed files through git

.node-version.reason: it selects the Node release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the runtime of every Node and TypeScript target

.go-version.reason: it selects the Go release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the toolchain of every Go target

.composer-version.reason: it selects the Composer release that installs the PHP dependencies of every PHP check in CI

.php-version.reason: it selects the PHP release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the runtime of every PHP target

LICENSE.reason: license text; no code or test reads it

clients/php/composer.lock.reason: it pins the PHP dependencies that every PHP check loads through the autoloader

clients/rust/rustfmt.toml.reason: it configures rustfmt, which rust-fmt-check runs over every Rust file

go.mod.reason: it pins the Go toolchain and the modules of every Go build and test

go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of every Go build and test

rust-toolchain.toml.reason: it selects the Rust toolchain of every Rust build and test, locally and in CI

internal/testdb/testdb.go.reason: every Go database test opens its database through it, so it changes the setup of every Go database target

clients/rust/case-clock/src/lib.rs.reason: every Rust test that checks the database clock takes its case clock from it

clients/rust/case-database/src/lib.rs.reason: every Rust database test creates and drops its case database through it

scripts/cargo-build-copy.sh.reason: every make target that runs a Rust program builds and copies that program through it (CARGO_COPY)
